title: betula microphylla var. utahensis
intro: Betula microphylla var. utahensis, commonly known as Utah dwarf birch, is a plant species in the birch family (Betulaceae) that is native to North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Utah dwarf birch include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
